excerpt: * The API is only available in session's `will-download` callback function. If
* `path` doesn't exist, Electron will try to make the directory recursively. If
* user doesn't set the save path via the API, Electron will use the original
* routine to determine the save path; this usually prompts a save dialog.
summary: Electron documents setSavePath as available synchronously inside will-download; if not assigned Electron uses original route which usually prompts save dialog. A combines original native callback path, genuine completion without path-selection UI, actual system getPath and unchanged real dialog delegation counters. Counters alone are not all NS panel evidence.
